instructions: Run each case in a fresh context with SKILL.md and its bundled reference. Provide prompt and observations only; withhold expected outcomes until reviewing the answer. These cases do not prove actual project generation, dependency resolution, Hook activation, or browser execution.

cases.prompt: Java/Spring으로 작은 할 일 앱 초기 구조까지 만들어줘. 팀은 JDK 21과 기존 Spring starter 버전을 써. 서버 렌더링 화면과 재시작 후에도 남는 할 일 데이터가 필요해. 개발 세부사항은 알아서 해줘. 배포는 필요 없어.
observations: Node 22 installed; JDK missing; no Docker
Team starter compatibility source not yet consulted
expected: Preserve Java/Spring and identify JDK setup and compatibility verification
Do not switch to Node or add a separate frontend just because Node is available
Use actual persistent data before the reference flow; Docker and deployment are not automatic
Do not claim a working scaffold before required setup and checks succeed

cases.prompt: 이 Spring 프로젝트는 이미 잘 돌아가. scaffold로 CLAUDE.md랑 검증 환경만 보강해줘.
observations: Existing team instructions and active formatter hook
scaffold-spec.md belongs to a different project goal
expected: Adapt existing harness and reuse verification command
Preserve application changes, active settings and old spec
Use a distinct spec path; do not reinitialize or replace architecture
Do not create another equivalent formatter or review workflow

cases.prompt: 파일 하나를 받아 결과를 출력하는 Python CLI의 scaffold 계획만 만들어줘. 저장소나 웹 UI는 필요 없어. Python 표준 라이브러리로 충분해. 구조 세부사항은 알아서 해줘.
expected: Plan only; no implementation or completion verification report
No forced DB, web server, Docker, MCP, LSP, release skill or repeated architecture questionnaire
Mark non-applicable dimensions with reasons
Define observable command success and meaningful failure evidence; do not invent unspecified product semantics

observations: Required: working browser TODO flow and active completion hook
Hook fixtures passed; actual runtime event not observed
CI workflow exists but remote CI not run
verifier file exists but no independent review occurred
expected: Preserve local build/API and hook-fixture successes as scoped evidence
Required UI is BLOCKED; runtime hook activation remains unverified
No overall scaffold completion claim
Do not claim remote CI or independent verification

cases.prompt: 공유 OpenAPI 계약을 사용하는 웹/모바일용 API 기반을 계획해줘. PostgreSQL과 Docker Compose를 쓰기로 결정했고 기술 호환성은 공식 문서로 확인했어. 예제는 할 일 생성과 조회야. 구현은 다음에 할 거야. 구조 세부사항은 알아서 해줘.
expected: Keep selected API, database and container choices
Order required service, data and contract/client generation before the consuming reference flow
Do not use a disposable stub that will be replaced with the selected data layer later
Stop at the plan without reasking settled architecture or claiming implementation

last_smoke.method: One independent review context evaluated five synthetic cases without expected outcomes; no real project was generated.
last_smoke.result: All five cases matched the expected decisions and boundaries.
last_smoke.followup: Clarified the plan-only stop sentence after review; checked the resulting instruction directly.
not_verified: Actual scaffold invocation and project generation
